verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review SaaS with a public API, so asking whether it offers a sandbox or test environment is fair. The evidence shows no isolated sandbox, test mode, or non-production workspace. The interactive API playground sends authenticated requests against the real API rather than an isolated sandbox. The local CLI review and the free trial are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
